verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਛਲ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pichhal raatee jaaganaa naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaae|

en.bdb: The Sikh awakes in the pre-dawn hour and meditating upon Nan, he becomes alert for ablution and charity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhe kai bhalaa manaae|

en.bdb: He speaks sweetly, moves humbly and giving away something by his hands for the well being of others feels happy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੋੜਾ ਸਵਣਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਥੋੜਾ ਬੋਲਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: thoRaa savanaa khaavanaa thoRaa bolan gurmat paae|

en.bdb: Sleeping and eating maderately he, according to the teachings of the Guru, also does not speak much.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ghaal khai sukirat karai vaddaa hoi na aap ganaae|

en.bdb: He toils to earn, performs good deeds and though being great never gets his greatness noticed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈਂ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat mil gaa(n)vadhe raat dhihai(n) nit chal chal jaae|

en.bdb: Walking for day and night he reaches where Gurbani is sung in the congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਪਰਚਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat parachaa karai satigur parachai man parachaae|

en.bdb: He keeps his consciousness merged in the Word and maintains in the mind love for the true Guru.
Amid hopes and desires, he remains detached.
